title: 第 十九章 征召第 二十章 尾巴
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
来人身着一袭黑红色长袍，正悠然的品着茶。
此人便是夏家家主的二公子，夏星辞。
陆引浩端坐在主位之上，内心却忐忑不安。
他强挤出一抹笑容，小心翼翼的问道：“夏公子，今日来，所为何事呀？”
此时，他满心担忧，生怕夏家知晓了陆行舟的存在又或许是他们家族那里得罪了夏家之人而来问罪的。
夏星辞并未理会他的询问，而是径直掏出一块灵牌，神色冷峻地的说道：“令，陆家须抽调五名修士，务必在半年内前往岭南县集合。
且这五名修士之中，必须有三名炼气中期修为。”
“违令者，灭族！”
夏星辞的语气中，透着不容商量。
陆引浩一听，心里顿时急了。
一下子要抽调五名修士，其中还得有三名炼气中期修为。
这对于本就缺少修士的陆家而言，无疑是雪上加霜。
要真这么抽调，陆家差不多就完啦。
陆引浩急忙站起身来，从腰间取下一个储物袋，双手递向夏星辞。
他满脸赔笑的说道：“夏公子，您也清楚我们陆家的处境，能不能通融通融，少征几个人呐？”
夏星辞接过储物袋，神识往里面一扫，见其中装着几百颗灵石，嘴角微微上扬。
但随即，他又恢复了严肃的神情，说道：“陆家主，并非我不通情理，可这是老祖的严令，我也实在是无能为力啊。”
说罢，他将储物袋往旁边轻轻一推。
“呵呵！夏公子，您看这样行不行，我亲自带队，再带两人，您看……？”陆引浩依旧满脸堆笑的说道。
他心里明白，夏家老祖既然下了这般要求，此事必定非同小可。

如今也只能寄希望于用自己的参与，来为陆家换取两个名额。
夏星辞手指在桌面上轻轻的敲打着，他低头在沉思。
一个炼气后期的修士，实力自然要比炼气中期的强上不少。
即便自己擅自答应下来，老祖宗应该也不会怪罪。
于是便点头说道：“可以，不过另外两名修士必须是中期修为。”
“没问题！”
陆引浩赶忙应道，说着又将储物袋往夏星辞那边推去。
夏星辞也不再推辞，直接将储物袋收了起来。
而后他站起身说道：“陆家主，我还要去通知其他家族，就不多打扰了。”
“夏公子有要事在身，请自便。”陆引浩赶忙说道。
待夏星辞离去后，陆引浩一刻也不敢耽搁，急忙派人通知家族中的各位长老，让他们速来议事厅。
待众人到齐，陆引浩将夏家征召一事详细的说了一遍。
众人听完，皆是愁容满面，神色凝重。
“大哥，夏家这次大规模征召，却对所为何事只字未提，此事恐怕没那么简单呐。”陆引媛忧心忡忡的说道。
“一下子抽调五人，这夏家也太狠了吧，陆家哪经得起这般折腾啊！”陆引齐愤愤不平的抱怨道。
陆引浩无奈的叹了口气。
“我已经和夏家的人商量好了，这次我亲自带队，还需要两人，你们谁愿意主动参加？”
“什么？你亲自带队，那家族怎么办？”陆引慧激动的说道。
“四妹，我带队能减少两人，家族如今的状况，这也是没办法。”
此言一出，在场众人皆陷入了沉默。

“我跟你去！”
“我也去！”
沉默片刻后，大家纷纷争先开口。
“引慧，引风，你们两个和我一起去，族里的事情就交给引齐负责了。”
content_en:
The visitor was wearing a black and red robe and was sipping tea leisurely.
This person is Xia Xingci, the second son of the head of the Xia family.
Lu Yinhao sat on the main seat, feeling uneasy in his heart.
He forced a smile and asked cautiously: "Mr. Xia, why are you here today?"
At this time, he was filled with worry, fearing that the Xia family would know about Lu Xingzhou's existence or that someone from his family might have offended the Xia family and come to question him.
Xia Xingci ignored his inquiry, but took out a spiritual tablet and said sternly: "Order, the Lu family must recruit five monks and must gather in Lingnan County within half a year.
And among these five monks, three must be in the middle stage of Qi Refining. "
"Those who disobey the order will be exterminated!"
Xia Xingci's tone showed that there was no room for negotiation.
When Lu Yinhao heard this, he suddenly became anxious.
Five monks must be recruited at once, and three of them must be in the middle stage of Qi refining.
This is undoubtedly adding insult to injury for the Lu family, which already lacks monks.
If this was really the case, the Lu family would be almost doomed.
Lu Yinhao stood up hurriedly, took out a storage bag from his waist, and handed it to Xia Xingci with both hands.
He said with an apologetic smile on his face: "Mr. Xia, you also know the situation of our Lu family. Can you be accommodating and recruit a few fewer people?"
Xia Xingci took the storage bag, glanced inside it with his consciousness, and saw that it contained hundreds of spirit stones, and the corners of his mouth raised slightly.
But then, he regained his serious expression and said, "Master Lu, it's not that I'm unreasonable, but this is the ancestor's strict order, and I really can't do anything about it."
After saying that, he gently pushed the storage bag aside.
"Haha! Mr. Xia, do you think this will work? I will lead the team myself and two more people. Do you think...?" Lu Yinhao said with a smile on his face.
He knew in his heart that since the ancestor of the Xia family made such a request, this matter must be no small matter.
Now I can only hope to use my participation to exchange for two places for the Lu family.
Xia Xingci tapped his fingers lightly on the table, lowering his head in thought.
A monk in the late stage of Qi refining is naturally much stronger than one in the middle stage of Qi refining.
Even if he agreed without authorization, his ancestors would not blame him.
So he nodded and said: "Yes, but the other two monks must be at the mid-level cultivation level."
"No problem!"
Lu Yinhao responded quickly and pushed the storage bag towards Xia Xingci.
Xia Xingci stopped refusing and put the storage bag away.
Then he stood up and said, "Master Lu, I have to inform other families, so I won't bother you any more."
"Master Xia has something important to do, please help yourself." Lu Yinhao said quickly.
After Xia Xingci left, Lu Yinhao did not dare to delay for a moment and hurriedly sent someone to notify the elders in the family and asked them to come to the meeting hall quickly.
When everyone arrived, Lu Yinhao explained the recruitment of the Xia family in detail.
After everyone listened, they all looked sad and solemn.
"Brother, the Xia family did not mention anything about the large-scale recruitment this time. I'm afraid it's not that simple." Lu Yinyuan said worriedly.
"The Xia family is too cruel to transfer five people at once. How can the Lu family withstand such a torment!" Lu Yinqi complained angrily.
Lu Yinhao sighed helplessly.
"I have already discussed it with the Xia family. I will personally lead the team this time. Two more people are needed. Which of you is willing to take the initiative to participate?"
"What? If you lead the team yourself, what will happen to the family?" Lu Yinhui said excitedly.
"Fourth sister, I can reduce the number of two people by leading the team. With the family's current situation, there is nothing we can do about it."
As soon as these words came out, everyone present fell into silence.
"I'll go with you!"
"I'll go too!"
After a moment of silence, everyone rushed to speak first.
"Yin Hui, Yin Feng, you two come with me, and I will leave the clan affairs to Yin Qi."
